title: lathyrus occidentalis
intro: Lathyrus occidentalis, commonly known as the Western sweetpea or Western pea, is a perennial legume native to the western United States and Canada. It is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Fabaceae family and is known for its vibrant purple flowers and fragrant foliage. The Western sweetpea has been found to have several health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of Lathyrus occidentalis, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as its potential to reduce oxidative stress and improve cardiovascular health.
